Abstract.AbstractText: A new isatin N,N'-cyclic azomethine imine synthon was devised, and an unexpected abnormal [3 + 2]-cycloaddition with maleimide catalyzed by 1,4-diazabicyclo[2.2.2]octane (DABCO) has been disclosed. A variety of tricyclic spiropyrrolidine oxindoles bearing a dinitrogen heterocycle and succinimide scaffold were obtained in excellent yields (up to 96%) and diastereoselectivities (up to 97:3) under mild conditions.
